vow.title: Take a vow?
vow.sub: Keep it and win to earn vow stars. It changes nothing on the field.
vow.secret: Only you know this vow. Win and keep it to earn
vow.restraint.name: Bhishma’s restraint
vow.restraint.rule: Win without your Senapati ever striking.
vow.guarded.name: The guarded fort
vow.guarded.rule: Win with your own fort gate never broken.
vow.clear-eyes.name: Clear eyes
vow.clear-eyes.rule: Win after your Divyadrishti reveals two different enemies.
vow.engineer.name: The patient engineer
vow.engineer.rule: Win after a Yantrik dismantles the Shataghni.
vow.open-road.name: The open road
vow.open-road.rule: Win after one Rath makes two runs of three cells or more without striking.
vow.dawn-watch.name: Dawn watch
vow.dawn-watch.rule: Win after taking a piece by day and another by night.
vow.joined-hands.name: Joined hands
vow.joined-hands.rule: Win after two captures with the Makara bonus.
vow.petal-guard.name: Petal guard
vow.petal-guard.rule: Win after a piece guarded by Padma throws back an attack.
vow.single-flame.name: A single flame
vow.single-flame.rule: Win after invoking exactly one astra.
vow.without-fire.name: Without fire
vow.without-fire.rule: Win without invoking Agneyastra or Brahmastra.
vow.companions.name: Companions return
vow.companions.rule: Win with at least six of your fighting pieces alive.
vow.breach-early.name: Breach before sunset
vow.breach-early.rule: Win by taking the enemy fort within 20 rounds.
